preconditions.description: The road width n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of safety islands m must be between 2 and the minimum of n + 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d_i <= n for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: All safety island coordinates must be within the range [0, n].
All safety island coordinates must be distinct.
The green light duration g and red light duration r must be between 1 and 1,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_time) if min_time != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum time to cross the road or -1 if it is impossible.
